title: pgy schema file
description: Declarative PostgreSQL schema definition consumed by pgy. Three formats are supported and may be mixed across merged files: top-level `schemas:`/`tables:` maps, a `tables:` list, and `schema <name>:` blocks (recommended).

extensions.description: PostgreSQL extensions to create. String shorthand implies ifNotExists: true.

schema.description: Schema to install the extension's objects into (WITH SCHEMA). Created if missing; a relocatable extension living elsewhere is moved with ALTER EXTENSION ... SET SCHEMA.

version.description: Extension version (VERSION). A live extension on another version is updated with ALTER EXTENSION ... UPDATE TO.

cascade.description: CASCADE: also install extensions this one requires.

comment.description: COMMENT ON EXTENSION, replacing the one its control file sets. Omitted = unmanaged.

set.description: ALTER DATABASE ... SET parameters (for all roles). Authoritative: unlisted settings are reset.

roles.description: Per-role settings in this database (ALTER ROLE ... IN DATABASE ... SET): role -> {parameter: value}. Authoritative for each listed role.

defaultPrivileges.description: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES: privileges granted automatically on objects created later. Grantees not listed are unmanaged; [] revokes everything from a grantee.

for.description: Role whose future objects are affected (default: the connecting role).

servers.description: Foreign servers (CREATE SERVER). When present, --unsafe --prune drops servers not listed. User mappings are not managed: their options hold credentials.

wrapper.description: FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER, e.g. postgres_fdw or file_fdw (provided by the extension of that name). Cannot be changed in place.

type.description: TYPE. Cannot be changed in place.

options.description: Wrapper options (OPTIONS (...)), e.g. host, port and dbname for postgres_fdw. Authoritative when present: unlisted options are dropped.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER SERVER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

publications.description: Logical replication publications (CREATE PUBLICATION). When present, --unsafe --prune drops publications not listed.

allTables.description: FOR ALL TABLES. Switching a live publication to or from it requires --unsafe (drop + create).

only.description: TABLE ONLY: publish the table without its inheritance children.

schemas.description: FOR TABLES IN SCHEMA (cannot be combined with column lists).

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER PUBLICATION ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

generatedColumns.description: publish_generated_columns (PostgreSQL 18+): stored also replicates stored generated columns. Omitted = unmanaged.

eventTriggers.description: Database-wide event triggers (CREATE EVENT TRIGGER). When present, --unsafe --prune drops event triggers not listed (extension-owned ones are kept).

tags.description: Command tags to fire on (WHEN TAG IN), e.g. CREATE TABLE.

roles.description: Cluster-level roles (CREATE ROLE). Passwords are intentionally unsupported: secrets do not belong in schema YAML.

schemas.description: Map of schema name to its tables (plus optional schema-level grants/comment).

tables.description: Tables in the public schema (unless names are schema-qualified). Map of table name to spec, or a list of specs with explicit name/schema.

columnRefs.description: Column names, either as a list or as a named block: `{ <name>: { columns: [...] } }`.

primaryKey.description: Primary key columns, either as a list or as a block naming the constraint: `{ <name>: { columns: [...], comment: ... } }`.

include.description: INCLUDE (non-key) columns of the key's index.

tablespace.description: Tablespace of the key's index (USING INDEX TABLESPACE); the tablespace must exist.

with.description: Storage parameters of the key's index, e.g. {fillfactor: 80}.

comment.description: COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT for the primary key.

grants.description: Privileges per role: `{ <role>: [select, insert, ...] }`. An empty list revokes all privileges for that role; omitting the grants block leaves live privileges unmanaged.

scalar.description: A YAML scalar (string, number, boolean, or date) rendered into SQL.

validUntil.description: VALID UNTIL: when the role's password expires, as a timestamp with a zone (2030-01-01T00:00:00Z), or infinity.

set.description: ALTER ROLE ... SET parameters for all databases. Authoritative: unlisted settings are reset.

inRoles.description: Role memberships: GRANT <parent> TO <role>. An entry is a role name, or a map that also sets the membership's options.

admin.description: WITH ADMIN OPTION: the member can grant the role to others.

inherit.description: WITH INHERIT (PostgreSQL 16+): the member has the role's privileges without SET ROLE. Defaults to the member's inherit attribute.

set.description: WITH SET (PostgreSQL 16+): the member can SET ROLE to the role.

schemasEntry.description: A schema under the `schemas:` map: optional grants/comment/owner plus tables keyed by plain table name.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER SCHEMA ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.
Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

data.description: Managed rows. Each row lists the columns it sets; rows are matched by key (the primary key when key is omitted).

of.description: Composite type of a typed table (CREATE TABLE ... OF type). Its columns come from the type; list them only to set their options (default, nullable: false, comment, ...), without a type.

inherits.description: Parent tables (INHERITS). Columns that only exist because a parent has them are left to the parent.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

columns.description: Columns as a map of name to spec, or a list of specs with explicit `name`.

replicaIdentity.description: REPLICA IDENTITY: default, full, nothing or index <name>.

clusterOn.description: Index to mark for CLUSTER (ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER ON); none removes the mark.

forceRowLevelSecurity.description: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY: policies apply to the table owner too. Turning it off requires --unsafe. Omitted = unmanaged.

rowLevelSecurity.description: true = ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, false = DISABLE (requires --unsafe). Omit to leave unmanaged.

partitionOf.description: Parent table this table is a partition of (schema-qualified or resolved against the current schema).

default.description: DEFAULT partition (used with partitionOf instead of forValues).

unlogged.description: UNLOGGED table (not WAL-logged, emptied after a crash). Changing it on a live table rewrites it and requires --unsafe.

tablespace.description: TABLESPACE for the table (a partitioned table: the default for new partitions); the tablespace must exist. Absent = unmanaged.

with.description: Storage parameters, e.g. {fillfactor: 70, autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor: 0.05}. When present, live parameters not listed are reset.

tableListItem.description: Table entry in the `tables:` list format.

data.description: Managed rows. Each row lists the columns it sets; rows are matched by key (the primary key when key is omitted).

of.description: Composite type of a typed table (CREATE TABLE ... OF type). Its columns come from the type; list them only to set their options (default, nullable: false, comment, ...), without a type.

inherits.description: Parent tables (INHERITS). Columns that only exist because a parent has them are left to the parent.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

replicaIdentity.description: REPLICA IDENTITY: default, full, nothing or index <name>.

clusterOn.description: Index to mark for CLUSTER (ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER ON); none removes the mark.

tablespace.description: TABLESPACE for the table; absent = unmanaged.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

type.description: PostgreSQL data type, e.g. uuid, text, timestamptz, numeric(10,2).

default.description: SQL default expression (e.g. now(), gen_random_uuid()) or literal. Bare booleans/numbers are rendered as SQL literals.

identity.description: Identity column: "always", "by default" (aliases: byDefault, default), or true (= always).

generated.description: Generated column expression: GENERATED ALWAYS AS (expr) STORED. Overrides default and identity.

collate.description: COLLATE for the column, e.g. C or und-x-icu. Changing it on a live column requires --unsafe.

compression.description: TOAST compression method (applies to newly written values).

statisticsTarget.description: Per-column statistics target (SET STATISTICS); -1 restores the default.

nDistinct.description: Planner override for the number of distinct values (SET (n_distinct = ...)): a positive count, or a negative fraction of the row count (-1 = all distinct). 0 removes the override.

nDistinctInherited.description: Like nDistinct, for statistics gathered across inheritance children and partitions (n_distinct_inherited).

virtual.description: With generated: VIRTUAL (computed when read) instead of STORED. PostgreSQL 18+.

notValid.description: Keep the column's NOT NULL constraint NOT VALID, so existing rows aren't checked and pgy diff never validates it. PostgreSQL 18+.

using.description: USING expression applied when the column type changes (ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE ... USING).

columnListItem.description: Column entry in the list format; same as the map form plus `name`.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.
Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

using.description: Index access method (default btree). Any access method the database has is accepted, including ones an extension adds (e.g. bloom).

where.description: Partial index predicate (without the WHERE keyword).

opclass.description: Operator class applied to every column (e.g. gin_trgm_ops), with its parameters in parentheses when it takes any (e.g. gist_trgm_ops(siglen=32)).

collations.description: Per-column COLLATE, keyed by the columns entry (e.g. {name: C}).

statisticsTargets.description: Per-expression statistics target (ALTER INDEX ... ALTER COLUMN n SET STATISTICS), keyed by the columns entry (e.g. {lower(email): 500}); -1 restores the default. PostgreSQL only allows expression columns.

opclasses.description: Per-column operator class overrides; keys match entries in columns. Parameters go in parentheses after the name (e.g. {name: gist_trgm_ops(siglen=32)}).

include.description: Non-key columns stored in the index (INCLUDE), for index-only scans.

nullsNotDistinct.description: Unique indexes: treat NULLs as equal (NULLS NOT DISTINCT, PostgreSQL 15+).

concurrently.description: On an existing table, build (and rebuild) the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY in a separate no-transaction migration.

tablespace.description: TABLESPACE for the index; absent = unmanaged. A concurrently index moves with REINDEX CONCURRENTLY.

with.description: Index storage parameters, e.g. {fillfactor: 70} or {fastupdate: false}.

comment.description: COMMENT ON INDEX text (diffed against live).

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

onDelete.description: ON DELETE action, e.g. cascade, restrict, set null, set default, no action.

onUpdate.description: ON UPDATE action, e.g. cascade, restrict, set null, set default, no action.

notValid.description: Add the constraint NOT VALID: existing rows are not checked.

comment.description: COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT text (diffed against live).

statistic.description: CREATE STATISTICS on columns and/or expressions of the table.

statisticsTarget.description: ALTER STATISTICS ... SET STATISTICS; -1 restores the default.

rule.description: A rewrite rule: CREATE RULE name AS ON event TO table [WHERE cond] DO [INSTEAD] action.

replace.description: Re-emit CREATE OR REPLACE RULE on every diff (actions are not compared).

timing.description: instead of: views only (always FOR EACH ROW).

referencing.description: Transition tables for AFTER triggers: REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS <old> NEW TABLE AS <new>.

comment.description: COMMENT ON TRIGGER text (diffed against live).

enabled.description: Trigger state: true/origin (default), false/disabled, replica or always.

procedure.description: Trigger function to execute, e.g. public.set_updated_at().

constraint.description: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER (must be AFTER ... FOR EACH ROW).

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

include.description: Unique only: INCLUDE (non-key) columns of the constraint's index.

tablespace.description: Unique and exclude: the tablespace of the constraint's index (USING INDEX TABLESPACE).

with.description: Unique only: storage parameters of the constraint's index.

notValid.description: Check only: add NOT VALID (existing rows are not checked).

enforced.description: Check only: false emits NOT ENFORCED (PostgreSQL 18+). Default true.

comment.description: COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT text (diffed against live).

for.description: Command the policy applies to (default all).

as.description: PERMISSIVE (default) policies are OR-ed together; RESTRICTIVE policies must all pass in addition.

to.description: Role name or list of role names (default: all roles).

comment.description: COMMENT ON POLICY text (diffed against live).

partitionBy.description: Partitioning strategy: explicit `{type, columns}` or shorthand `{range: [...]}` / `{list: [...]}` / `{hash: [...]}`.

transform.description: Types of the routine's TRANSFORM FOR TYPE clause, e.g. [hstore, jsonb] (the transforms come from extensions such as hstore_plpython3u and jsonb_plperl). Omit to leave the routine's transforms unmanaged; [] declares none.

function.description: Body of a `function <name>(args):` declaration. Arguments belong in the key, not the body.

replace.description: Re-emit a SQL-standard body (BEGIN ATOMIC ... END or RETURN expr) with CREATE OR REPLACE. PostgreSQL stores such bodies rewritten, so pgy does not compare them; set this while changing one.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

returns.description: Return type, e.g. trigger, jsonb, setof record.

strict.description: STRICT (returns null on null input). Omit to leave unmanaged.

parallel.description: PARALLEL safety. Omit to leave unmanaged.

cost.description: COST in cpu_operator_cost units. Omit to leave unmanaged.

rows.description: ROWS estimate (set-returning functions only). Omit to leave unmanaged.

set.description: SET parameter = value clauses, e.g. search_path: public. Values are quoted when needed; only list parameters such as search_path are split on commas.

revokePublic.description: Revoke the default PUBLIC execute privilege (security-definer pattern).

procedure.description: Body of a `procedure <name>(args):` declaration. Procedures have no return type or volatility; invoked with CALL.

replace.description: Re-emit a SQL-standard body (BEGIN ATOMIC ... END or RETURN expr) with CREATE OR REPLACE. PostgreSQL stores such bodies rewritten, so pgy does not compare them; set this while changing one.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

set.description: SET parameter = value clauses, as for functions.

typeDef.description: Body of a `type <name>:` declaration (enum, composite or range).

renamedLabels.description: Enums: new label -> previous label (ALTER TYPE ... RENAME VALUE).

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

revokePublic.description: Revoke PUBLIC's default USAGE (REVOKE USAGE ... FROM PUBLIC).

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

subtypeOpclass.description: Range: btree operator class for the subtype.

collation.description: Range: collation for a collatable subtype.

subtypeDiff.description: Range: difference function, used by GiST.

multirangeTypeName.description: Range: name for the multirange type (default <name>_multirange or derived).

attributes.description: Composite attributes: `{ <name>: { type: <sql type>, collate: <collation> } }`, or the shorthand `{ <name>: <sql type> }`.

collate.description: COLLATE for the attribute; changing it on a live type requires --unsafe.

comment.description: COMMENT ON COLUMN for the attribute.

view.description: Body of a `view <name>:` or `materialized view <name>:` declaration.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

query.description: The SELECT statement defining the view.

replace.description: Always emit CREATE OR REPLACE (live view definitions cannot be reliably text-compared).

securityInvoker.description: Views: security_invoker option — check permissions as the querying user (PostgreSQL 15+).

checkOption.description: Views: WITH CHECK OPTION level; none removes it.

withData.description: Materialized views: false creates WITH NO DATA (populate later with REFRESH).

with.description: Materialized views: storage parameters (WITH (...), e.g. fillfactor, autovacuum_enabled, toast.autovacuum_enabled). Authoritative when present: unlisted parameters are reset.

indexes.description: Materialized views: indexes, same format as table indexes (a unique index enables REFRESH ... CONCURRENTLY).

triggers.description: Plain views: triggers, typically timing: instead of, to make the view writable.

columnComments.description: Views: COMMENT ON COLUMN per view column.

columnDefaults.description: Plain views: DEFAULT expressions for view columns (ALTER VIEW ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET DEFAULT), used by inserts through the view.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

unlogged.description: UNLOGGED sequence (PostgreSQL 15+): ALTER SEQUENCE ... SET LOGGED / UNLOGGED when it changes.

tsConfig.description: Body of a `text search configuration <name>:` declaration.

parser.description: Parser to start from instead (usually default).

mappings.description: Token type -> dictionaries in order; [] removes the mapping. Unlisted token types are unmanaged.

tsDictionary.description: Body of a `text search dictionary <name>:` declaration (create-only).

template.description: e.g. simple, snowball, ispell, synonym, thesaurus.

identityOptions.description: Identity column with sequence options: GENERATED <generated> AS IDENTITY (START WITH ... INCREMENT BY ...).

sequenceName.description: Name of the identity's sequence (SEQUENCE NAME); unqualified, it is in the table's schema. A changed name renames the live sequence.

aggregate.description: Body of an `aggregate <name>(args):` declaration (CREATE OR REPLACE AGGREGATE). Use (*) for count(*)-style aggregates.

combinefunc.description: Combines two states, enabling parallel aggregation.

initcond.description: Initial state value (as a string literal).

sspace.description: Average state size in bytes, a planner hint.

finalfuncExtra.description: FINALFUNC_EXTRA: pass the aggregate's arguments to finalfunc as extra (null) arguments.

serialfunc.description: Serializes an internal state for parallel aggregation.

msfunc.description: Moving-aggregate forward transition function (with minvfunc and mstype).

sortop.description: Sort operator for min/max-like aggregates, e.g. > or myschema.>.

hypothetical.description: HYPOTHETICAL: an ordered-set aggregate whose direct arguments are matched to the aggregated ones, as rank and dense_rank are (the args must use ORDER BY).

collation.description: Body of a `collation <name>:` declaration (CREATE COLLATION). Create-only.

from.description: Copy an existing collation instead (CREATE COLLATION ... FROM).

foreignTable.description: Body of a `foreign table <name>:` declaration (CREATE FOREIGN TABLE).

server.description: Foreign server the table reads through, usually declared under servers:. Cannot be changed in place.

partitionOf.description: Parent table this table is a partition of (schema-qualified or resolved against the current schema).

default.description: DEFAULT partition (used with partitionOf instead of forValues).

options.description: Foreign-data wrapper table options (OPTIONS (...)), e.g. schema_name and table_name for postgres_fdw. Authoritative when present: unlisted options are dropped.

columns.description: Columns as a map of name to spec.

owner.description: Owner role (ALTER ... OWNER TO), diffed against live.

renamedFrom.description: Previous name. When only that name exists live, pgy renames it (ALTER ... RENAME) instead of creating a new object; once applied it is a no-op.

foreignColumn.description: Foreign table column: a table column without keys, identity, generation or storage settings, plus the wrapper's column options.

type.description: PostgreSQL data type, e.g. uuid, text, timestamptz, numeric(10,2).

default.description: SQL default expression (e.g. now(), gen_random_uuid()) or literal. Bare booleans/numbers are rendered as SQL literals.

collate.description: COLLATE for the column, e.g. C or und-x-icu. Changing it on a live column requires --unsafe.

statisticsTarget.description: Per-column statistics target (SET STATISTICS); -1 restores the default.

nDistinct.description: Planner override for the number of distinct values (SET (n_distinct = ...)): a positive count, or a negative fraction of the row count (-1 = all distinct). 0 removes the override.

nDistinctInherited.description: Like nDistinct, for statistics gathered across inheritance children and partitions (n_distinct_inherited).

using.description: USING expression applied when the column type changes (ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE ... USING).

options.description: Foreign-data wrapper column options (OPTIONS (...)), e.g. column_name for postgres_fdw. Authoritative when present: unlisted options are dropped.

revokePublic.description: Revoke PUBLIC's default USAGE (REVOKE USAGE ... FROM PUBLIC).

check.description: CHECK expression; the value is referenced as VALUE.

notNullName.description: Name of the NOT NULL constraint (PostgreSQL 17+); default <domain>_not_null.

constraintName.description: Optional name for the CHECK constraint.

checks.description: Named CHECK constraints (name: expression, referencing VALUE), or name: {check, comment} to also comment the constraint. Authoritative: with --unsafe, undeclared checks are dropped and changed ones replaced.
